note: A thrust curve the app had already downloaded was kept in your browser and read before anything else, and it recorded the samples but not the rule that picked them - so v0.107's fix to how the app chooses between a motor's published curves never reached a motor you had already flown. Of the 810 motors with more than one published file, 158 come out different under the corrected rule and 14 of those by more than 3 percent of total impulse. Refreshing discards the stored curves and re-fetches them; nothing else in your browser is touched.
